user.title: Shutter Captain
user.description: Sets up the central shutter automation. Afterwards add shutters with 'Add shutter' and adjust times and alarms under 'Configure' – or in the 'Shutter Captain' sidebar panel.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Shutter Captain is already set up.

area_living.title: Living area
area_living.description: Times for all shutters assigned to this area.

data_description.living_mode: Fixed time, sunrise/sunset or golden hour – always limited by the times below.
data_description.living_down_week: Latest close time when tomorrow is a workday (also on Sundays).
data_description.living_down_weekend: Used when tomorrow is free – so also on Fridays.
data_description.living_stagger: Seconds between two shutters of this area (less radio traffic).

area_sleep.title: Sleeping area
area_sleep.description: Times for all shutters assigned to this area.

data_description.sleep_mode: Fixed time, sunrise/sunset or golden hour – always limited by the times below.
data_description.sleep_down_week: Latest close time when tomorrow is a workday (also on Sundays).
data_description.sleep_down_weekend: Used when tomorrow is free – so also on Fridays.
data_description.sleep_stagger: Seconds between two shutters of this area (less radio traffic).

area_children.title: Children's area
area_children.description: Times for all shutters assigned to this area.

data_description.children_mode: Fixed time, sunrise/sunset or golden hour – always limited by the times below.
data_description.children_down_week: Latest close time when tomorrow is a workday (also on Sundays).
data_description.children_down_weekend: Used when tomorrow is free – so also on Fridays.
data_description.children_stagger: Seconds between two shutters of this area (less radio traffic).

data_description.sun_end_elevation: Compensates for shade from buildings or trees.
data_description.stagger: Seconds between shutters for astro, brightness and group commands.

data_description.workday_entity: E.g. the Workday integration – detects public holidays. Empty = only Sat/Sun free.
data_description.workday_tomorrow_entity: Workday with day offset 1 – closes later before holidays.
data_description.vacation_entity: When on: weekend times. There is also a 'Vacation' switch.
data_description.school_holiday_entity: Calendar or switch; enables weekend opening for areas with the school-holiday option.

data_description.brightness_delay: How long the value must hold before moving (against clouds).
data_description.brightness_close_from: Before this time only opening, after it only closing.

data.min_minutes_since_move: Open only if last move older than

data_description.late_close_time: For shutters with 'Late close' – ignores lockout protection!
data_description.random_offset: Shifts the times randomly each day by up to this many minutes. 0 = off.

data_description.emergency_entity: E.g. smoke detector. Highest priority: overrides alarms, manual mode and the main switch for all shutters. Awnings retract.
data_description.frost_temp_entity: Outside temperature for frost protection and frost lock (sensor or weather entity).
data_description.frost_protect_below: Below this the frost alarm is active, like with the frost trigger: shutters with the frost alarm close to the frost position, shutters with a frost opening position only open that far. Off again 1 °C above. −50 = off.
data_description.frost_lock_below: Below this, shutters with 'Frost lock' are no longer moved automatically (frozen). Manual control still works. −50 = off.

data_description.roof_window_rain_entity: On/rain or rain amount > 0 → roof windows close – also in manual mode and with the main switch off.
data_description.roof_window_wind_entity: Switch/binary sensor (on = wind) or wind speed in km/h.
data_description.roof_window_vent_level: The vent button opens the roof windows this far. Not in rain or wind.
data_description.roof_window_auto_close_minutes: When a roof window has been open this long. 0 = off.
data_description.roof_window_close_time: Closes open roof windows at this time. 00:00 = off.
data_description.roof_window_wait_time: At least the travel time of the roof window.

data_description.wait_time: At least the shutter travel time. Moves during this time are not treated as manual.
data_description.command_gap: Applies to all shutters together – never several radio commands at once (Homematic IP duty cycle).
data_description.manual_round: Moving by hand to a configured height keeps the automation active.

data_description.accent: Colour for panel and dashboard card. 'Home Assistant' = your theme colour.
data_description.weather_entity: Shows rain, snow and clouds in the window of panel and card.
data_description.forecast_entity: Weather entity with a daily forecast for 'Only if today's forecast reaches'. Empty = weather entity above.

data.awning_emergency_alarms: Also retract on the shutters fire alarm and emergency input

data_description.awning_wind_entity: Switch/binary sensor (on = wind) or wind speed in km/h.
data_description.awning_rain_entity: On/rain or rain amount > 0 → awnings retract.
data_description.awning_min_temp: On top of sun protection: only extend when at least this warm. 0 = ignore.
data_description.awning_retract_time: Awnings then stay in until midnight. 00:00 = off (they then retract with the sun).
data_description.awning_sun_end_elevation: Below this sun elevation awnings retract (shade from buildings or trees).
data_description.awning_emergency_entities: E.g. smoke detectors (several possible). Highest priority for awnings: they retract at once – even in manual mode or with the main switch off.
data_description.awning_wait_time: At least the awning travel time. Moves during this time are not treated as manual.
data_description.awning_manual_round: Moving by hand to a configured height keeps the automation active.

data.garage_emergency_alarms: Emergency opener also on fire alarm and emergency input

data_description.garage_emergency_entities: E.g. smoke detectors (several possible). HIGHEST PRIORITY – overrides everything: as soon as one triggers, the garage door always opens fully (escape route) – no matter what else is set, even in manual mode, with the main switch off, conditions or times. While active the door never closes automatically.
data_description.garage_emergency_alarms: Also opens the garage doors when the fire alarm or the emergency input (Alarms) triggers – with the same highest priority.
data_description.garage_open_level: How far the automation opens the door (100% = fully). Only for doors that report a position; otherwise it opens fully.
data_description.garage_close_level: The automation closes the door down to this height (0% = fully closed). Only for doors that report a position; otherwise it closes fully.
data_description.garage_vent_level: The vent button moves the door to this height. "Close automatically after" then waits; closing in the evening, when everyone left or by condition still happens. Needs a door that reports a position.
data_description.garage_position_tolerance: Deviation in % that still counts as reached (opening, closing and vent height).
data_description.garage_auto_close_minutes: When the door has been open this long. 0 = off.
data_description.garage_close_time: Closes open garage doors at this time. 00:00 = off.
data_description.garage_presence_entity: Person, group or zone: when it changes to away/off, garage doors close.
data_description.garage_arrival_entities: One or more persons: when one of them changes to home, the garage door opens (if "opening only allowed while" is met).
data_description.garage_open_mode: "Open when met": the door opens as soon as the condition becomes true. "Opening only allowed while": automatic opening (e.g. on arrival) only while it is true.
data_description.garage_close_mode: "Close when met": the door closes as soon as the condition becomes true. "Closing only allowed while": automatic closing (time, duration, everyone left) only while it is true.
data_description.garage_light_entity: Turned on as soon as the door opens – also by hand or remote.
data_description.garage_light_minutes: How long the light stays on after opening before it turns off. 0 = stays on (until closing, if set below).
data_description.garage_light_off_on_close: Turns the light off once the door is closed – after the delay.
data_description.garage_light_close_delay: How long the light stays on after closing. 0 = off immediately.

data_description.name: Empty = name of the cover entity.
data_description.device_type: Awning: wind and rain alarms move it to the closed (retracted) position.
data_description.garage_switch_entity: Optional: switch, button or relay that moves the door (e.g. Shelly with auto-off). Shutter Captain then sends an impulse instead of the cover command; the position still comes from the cover above.
data_description.area: Which area group the shutter belongs to. Automatic = taken from 'Open/Close by'.

data_description.window_profile: Terrace door: up when opened, never down while open, back to automation after closing · Vent window: vent position when opened/tilted, at night first closed then vent position · Protection only: no reaction, but never down while open · Custom: the single fields below.
data_description.tilt_entity: Separate sensor for 'tilted'. Sensors with state 'tilted' are detected too.
data_description.lockout: Which direction the automation may move while the window/door is open.
data_description.vent_on_close: With an open window, close fully first, then move to the window position.

data_description.sun_mode: All selected triggers must be active. A light sensor is ANDed on top.
data_description.sun_tilt: For venetian blinds. −1 = do not change.
data_description.light_hyst: Example: 30,000 lx and 40% → active until below 18,000 lx.
data_description.sun_start_delay: Sun must shine this long without a break – avoids up and down with passing clouds.
data_description.sun_month_from: 1–12, may wrap the new year, e.g. 4 to 9. Keeps winter sun inside.
data_description.forecast_temp: Maximum temperature of the weather forecast (weather entity under Settings → Appearance). 0 = ignore.
data_description.weather_conditions: Empty = ignore. Otherwise the current weather must be one of these.

data_description.cond_mode: Sun protection only when met · evening close only to the level below · don't close · don't open.

data_description.close1_entity: E.g. a light turning on. Closes in addition to the time/brightness automation.
data_description.close2_enabled: After a full close (stage 1) moves to a second position/slat angle – only with automation on, no lock and the window closed.
data_description.close2_logic: AND: all configured triggers (brightness, time, entity) must apply · OR: one is enough. Without a trigger stage 2 never runs.
data_description.open2_enabled: In the morning first only to a partial position, fully open later – by brightness, time or entity. Without a trigger it opens fully at once.

data_description.privacy_level: Button and service 'Privacy' – held until the next scheduled event.
data_description.my_level: Favourite position for the 'My position' button and service – held until the next scheduled event.
data_description.frost_open_level: While frost is active (frost trigger or temperature) the automation only opens up to this position. −1 = off.
data_description.frost_lock: Below the frost lock temperature (Settings → Alarms) this shutter is not moved automatically at all – protects frozen curtains and motors.
data_description.insect_enabled: Once a day briefly fully up and back to the previous position (slats included) – drives insects out of the shutter box. Skipped when the shutter was fully up that day. Waits while the window is open, a lock, alarm or frost is active or the automation is off.

data_description.lamp_entity: Turned on with automatic closing and off again when opening.

no_shutter_for_entity.message: No Shutter Captain shutter is configured for this entity.

command.name: Group command
command.description: Opens, closes, sets sun protection or resumes automation for an area.

action.name: Action
action.description: open, close, sun_protect, auto or manual

area.name: Area
area.description: all, living, sleep or children (shutters only)

device_type.name: Device type
device_type.description: shutter, awning, garage or roof_window – awnings, garage doors and roof windows: always all of the type

pause.name: Pause automation
pause.description: Holds the shutters in place, e.g. during a party.

vent.name: Vent
vent.description: Moves the shutters to their vent position and holds it until the next scheduled event.

privacy.name: Privacy
privacy.description: Moves to the privacy position and holds it until the next scheduled event.

override_lockout.name: Override lockout
override_lockout.description: Only after confirmation: also move down while the door is open.

my_position.name: My position
my_position.description: Moves to the My position and holds it until the next scheduled event.

override_lockout.name: Override lockout
override_lockout.description: Only after confirmation: also move down while the door is open.

resume.name: Resume automation
resume.description: Ends manual mode/pause and moves to the automation position.
